typography.instructions: Avoid generic sans for headings (e.g. use Manrope or Work Sans). Maintain readable text hierarchy.

surfaces_and_shapes.shadows: Light edge shadows on all containers (shadow-sm)
surfaces_and_shapes.borders: rounded-xl for main containers, rounded-md for inputs/buttons

layout.spacing: Dense spacing for dashboards (p-4 to p-6). Form elements use gap-4 instead of gap-8 to stay compact.
layout.grids: Use grid-cols-2 or flex-row to utilize horizontal space and reduce vertical scrolling.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write standard React JS syntax.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or any surface over content (e.g. Dropdown backgrounds).
Use Shadcn UI components where applicable, customizing them to fit the Light Dashboard theme.
Apply micro-interactions on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50) using specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors), NEVER transition-all.
Ensure high contrast text (APCA standard) and accessible focus states.
